# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Package documentation refresh**

## Highlights

Upcoming SkiaSharp packages will ship compiler-generated XML documentation beside their managed assemblies. Public API documentation now originates in C# XML comments, making package reference documentation consistent with the maintained source.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation is generated from source** — NuGet packages include compiler-generated XML documentation, with public API remarks authored alongside the C# declarations. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Generated interop bindings are organized by type** — P/Invoke declarations are split into per-type generated files without changing the managed API surface. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056))
